name: Waikato Regional Council
description: Named in A geospatial surge (Chapter 42). Follow the linked passage for context.
story: Waikato Regional Council used GIS across environmental management and emergency management. Derek Phyn’s documented work and the NZGIS4EM community place council GIS staff in the development of national geospatial emergency-management practice.

sources.label: Derek Phyn, New Zealand GIS for Emergency Management, ISCRAM 2018
